what_matters.head: Nvidia fell about 8% after hours on Wednesday, after the Wall Street Journal reported that its board is preparing to remove Jensen Huang as chief executive.
what_matters.detail: The Journal, citing people familiar with the matter, said the board planned to meet as soon as Wednesday to decide his future. The New York Times reported the same day that Huang had a relationship with an Nvidia executive who reports to him (as described by the Journal). Nvidia had closed the regular session up 2.9%, so the fall is not in Wednesday's US closing prices. Nasdaq 100 futures were down 1% and S&P 500 futures 0.4% at 08:25 SGT (Investing.com). No statement from Nvidia or its board was found by 13:20 SGT. Nvidia reports results on 17 Nov.

what_matters.head: CoreWeave rose 24.7% on Wednesday, about 4.5 times its usual daily move, and chip, memory and power shares rose with it. Eight watchlist names moved at least twice their usual amount.
what_matters.detail: It was CoreWeave's best day since April 2025, the session after its Q3 results (CNBC). Chief executive Michael Intrator told CNBC that demand for this infrastructure "outpaces the world's capacity to deliver infrastructure". Memory shares had fallen the week before on fears that a Democratic Congress could slow data-centre building (Benzinga). Each name's move is under Movers.

what_matters.head: Nebius reports Q3 results tonight at about 20:00 SGT and Cerebras at about 05:05 SGT on Friday.
what_matters.detail: Nebius rose 15.4% on Wednesday ahead of its results. Details under Earnings.

latest.tape_note: On Wednesday the S&P 500 fund rose 1.3% and the Nasdaq 100 fund 2.3%. The chip fund rose 6.0%, about 1.8 times its usual daily move, and is up 3.5% over five sessions. The dollar index rose 0.8%, about 2.2 times usual, as Fed speakers warned about inflation and futures put the chance of a quarter-point rate rise in December at 91.9% (CME FedWatch, via Reuters). The US dollar rose 0.2% against the Singapore dollar. The 10-year yield ended at 5.00%, up 1 basis point. The VIX fell 10.1%. Gold fell 1.1% and US crude 0.4%.

recent.headline: Nvidia fell about 8% after hours on Wednesday, after the Wall Street Journal reported that its board is preparing to remove Jensen Huang as chief executive.
Nvidia fell another 5.5% on Tuesday, about 2.3 times its usual daily move, on twice its average volume. It is down 18.3% over five sessions.
US stocks had their biggest rally in about seven months on Monday: the S&P 500 fund rose 2.4% and the chip fund 7.5%.
Chip stocks bounced on Friday after their worst sell-off since 2020: the chip fund rose 3.5% and AMD 11%.
Wall Street's AI stocks sold off hard: the S&P 500 fund fell 4.4%, about 6.6 times its usual daily move, and the chip fund 12.2%.
